seven_pt6_adjudication.source_basis: 7PT6 is a Cdc7-Dbf4/MCM2-7 ATP-gamma-S state, but the scan found no heteromeric acceptor within 6 Angstrom of any AGS PG. Several MCM-chain AGS donors approach MCM-chain Ser residues at 6.09-6.64 Angstrom, just outside the lane bound and not Cdc7-associated. The Cdc7-associated AGS donor is nearest to DBF4 Tyr668 at 15.243 Angstrom, not to an MCM phosphoacceptor.

six_ya7_adjudication.source_basis: 6YA7 is source-relevant Cdc7-Dbf4 bound to an Mcm2-S40 derived bivalent substrate, but this scan found no ATP/ANP/ACP/AGS gamma donor atom, so it is not clean gamma-transfer evidence.

evidence_against: The Cdc7/MCM gamma-donor family follow-up reviewed 6YA7 and 7PT6 and found no within-6-Angstrom heteromeric gamma/acceptor candidate.
7PT6 has Cdc7-associated AGS/Mg, but its nearest heteromeric acceptor is DBF4 Tyr668 at 15.243 Angstrom, not an MCM substrate site.
6YA7 is source-relevant for Cdc7/Mcm2-S40 substrate binding but has no active gamma donor under the lane scan.
source_review_summary.recommendation: Keep Cdc7/MCM as review-only evidence against clean local transfer-state evidence for now. Do not change production scoring, labels, thresholds, registries, or fingerprints.
